The season was divided into two tournaments (Apertura and Clausura) and determined the 61st and 62nd national champions. The campaign began on 28 July 2012,{{Deprecated archive|url=https://archive.today/20120801073226/http://www.diez.hn/Inicio/Ediciones/2012/05/26/Noticias/21-de-julio-arrancaria-proxima-temporada-en-Honduras%23.T8FYksWxmPR|title=Diez.hn–21 de julio arrancaría próxima temporada en Honduras}}–26 May 2012[http://www.diez.hn/Inicio/Ediciones/2012/06/16/Noticias/Inicio-la-asamblea-de-Liga-Nacional#.T9z1X8XQsXg Diez.hn–Inició la asamblea de Liga Nacional] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120618152831/http://www.diez.hn/Inicio/Ediciones/2012/06/16/Noticias/Inicio-la-asamblea-de-Liga-Nacional#.T9z1X8XQsXg |date=2012-06-18 }}–16 June 2012 and ended in May 2013. Victoria]] also qualified along Olimpia directly to the semifinals finishing second. On the other hand, [[F.C. Motagua|C.D. Motagua]]–Real España and [[C.D. Marathón]]–Atlético Choloma had to play a playoff round. The semifinal encounters were settled on 21 November, as Motagua and Atlético Choloma defeated Real España and Marathón respectively. Motagua crushed Real España with a 7–3 on aggregate.[http://www.laprensa.hn/Secciones-Principales/Deportes/Liga-de-Honduras/Motagua-certifico-su-boleto-a-las-semifinales-con-otro-triunfo LaPrensa.hn–Motagua certificó su boleto a las semifinales con otro triunfo]–21 November 2012 Meanwhile, Atlético Choloma dispatched Marathón after a 2–2 aggregated score but with more away goals scored.{{Deprecated archive|url=https://archive.today/20130217154422/http://www.laprensa.hn/Secciones-Principales/Deportes/Liga-de-Honduras/Atletico-Choloma-despacha-al-Marathon|title=LaPrensa.hn–Atlético Choloma despacha al Marathón}}–21 November 2012 Once in the semifinals, Olimpia got rid of Atlético Choloma with a 2–1 aggregate, meanwhile Victoria and Motagua finished with a 3–3 global score, however, Victoria advanced thanks to a better regular season finish over Motagua. With their success in the semifinals, Olimpia and Victoria re-encountered each other in a final for the third time in history,{{Deprecated archive|url=https://archive.today/20130217173733/http://www.latribunadeportiva.hn/2012/12/04/olimpia-y-victoria-a-su-tercera-final/|title=LaTribunaDeportiva.hn–Olimpia y Victoria a su tercera final}}–4 December 2012 having won one each in the previous two.
